description: "Which SBIR or STTR solicitations are open at [agency]?" / "current SBIR topics" / "open DoD SBIR solicitations" / "SBIR proposal deadlines" / "SBIR opportunities for [research area]" — active SBIR/STTR funding opportunities merged from three live sources: www.sbir.gov/topics (multi-agency topic listing), the DoD/DARPA topics-app JSON API (Pre-Release and Open DoD topics sbir.gov itself does not yet carry), and Grants.gov (NIH/HHS SBIR & STTR Notices of Funding Opportunity, which never appear as sbir.gov "topics" at all — e.g. the NIH parent SBIR/STTR announcements and NCI omnibus solicitations). Every result names its own `program` (SBIR or STTR) and `source`, and a Grants.gov hit is only ever labelled SBIR/STTR when its own title or NIH activity code says so — a plain, unrelated grant is never presented as SBIR. Filter by keyword, agency (e.g., "DOD", "DARPA", "NSF", "NASA", "DOE", "HHS", "NIH"), and open/closed status. This is the tool for open federal small-business R&D solicitations and topics; for who already WON SBIR money use sbir_search_awards.

agency.description: Filter by agency: DOD, HHS, NASA, NSF, DOE, USDA, EPA, DOC, ED, DOT, DHS, NIH, DARPA, ARMY, NAVY, USAF, and others sbir.gov itself lists. "DOW" is also accepted and translated to "DOD".

keyword.description: Search term to match against solicitation/topic titles and descriptions.

limit.description: Number of results to return across all sources combined (default 20, max 100).

open_only.description: Only return currently open (or pre-release) solicitations (default true). false also includes recently closed sbir.gov/topics results — the DoD app and Grants.gov legs are open-opportunities-only sources and are skipped when this is false.

name: sbir_search_solicitations

open_only.description: Whether only open solicitations were returned
